title: Sum of digits
code:
#include <iostream>
int main(){ int n=1234,sum=0; while(n){sum+=n%10;n/=10;} std::cout<<sum<<"\n"; }

title: Prime numbers from 1 to n
code:
#include <iostream>
int main(){ int n=30; for(int x=2;x<=n;++x){bool prime=true; for(int d=2;d*d<=x;++d) if(x%d==0){prime=false;break;} if(prime) std::cout<<x<<" ";} }
